description: What is said, with the time of every word when the source has it: captions first, then the configured fallback engine. Writes transcript.json and transcript.md to the workspace and returns the text (long transcripts are shortened; read transcript.md for all of it).

language.description: Preferred caption language code, e.g. "en" or "ru".

max_chars.description: Most characters of transcript to return inline.

source.description: The video: a link (YouTube and other sites), a path to a local file, or `inbox` for the newest file in the inbox folder.

name: transcript
title: Word-timed transcript
